svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Retrieval augmented generation with open components
svg.desc: Retrieval augmented generation with open components. 14 components in 2 groups. Connections: Documents to Loaders; Loaders to Chunking; Chunking to Embedding; Embedding to bge-m3; Embedding to Qdrant (upsert); User to React; React to FastAPI (POST /chat); FastAPI to LangChain; FastAPI to Redis; LangChain to Qdrant (search); LangChain to Ollama (prompt and context); LangChain to Hosted model API (alternative); LangChain to Langfuse.

text.tspan: Retrieval augmented generation with open components
Documents are chunked and embedded into Qdrant; a FastAPI and LangChain backend retrieves context and answers with a local Ollama model or a hosted one
